newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: "Ninja Turtles" rob Argentine ice-cream parlor.
newsitem.headline: "Ninja Turtles" rob Argentine ice-cream parlor.

text.p: Shouting "I am Michelangelo, he is Donatello and we want the money," two thieves dressed as Ninja Turtles robbed an ice-cream parlour in a ritzy Buenos Aires district.
They stole $200 from the Freddo store in Recoleta and as much jewelry as they could from cone-slurping customers just after midnight Monday, local newspapers reported Wednesday.
The thieves wore Ninja Turtle costumes but used handguns -- rather than the oriental-style swords favoured by the cartoon characters.
